class.name: neural_controller/KeyframeController
class.description: Deterministic lift and encoder-based wheel alignment with shared startup calibration.

class.name: neural_controller/InvertedTriangleController
class.description: Staged rigid inverted-triangle flip, with a session-bound reference and shared calibration gate.

class.name: neural_controller/TriangleRollController
class.description: Simultaneous rigid triangle roll and bounded support settling; no walking.

class.name: neural_controller/HubRollController
class.description: Supported half-turn diagnostic: hold measured proximal angles and turn all four hubs; no approach, load correction, or walking.

class.name: neural_controller/JointPoseController
class.description: Supported named-joint positioning with bounded inward recovery, staged upper/hub motion, and torque limits.
